title: Belrose Promotional Financing Plans — Term Schedule: Amounts, Scores, Down Payments and Applicant Conditions

# Belrose Promotional Financing Plans — Term Schedule: Amounts, Scores, Down Payments and Applicant Conditions

Belrose Promotional Financing Plans are written on one of six promotional terms. Each term is offered for a fixed band of financed amounts, is approved only from a stated bureau credit score and applicant age, takes a stated share of the ticket at the till, and sets its own limits on how many plans of that term a customer may hold and how much the customer may owe across all open plans when the term is written. The schedule below is the term-by-term basis for those conditions.

## 1. Schedule by term

| Term | Promotional term (whole months from activation) | Interest structure | Smallest financed amount | Largest financed amount | Smallest down payment, share of the pre-tax ticket | Lowest bureau credit score | Minimum applicant age, whole years |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 6-Month Deferred Interest Plan | 6 | deferred interest | 299.00 USD | 2499.00 USD | 0 percent | 620 | 18 |
| 12-Month Deferred Interest Plan | 12 | deferred interest | 799.00 USD | 6999.00 USD | 0 percent | 640 | 18 |
| 18-Month Deferred Interest Plan | 18 | deferred interest | 1499.00 USD | 12499.00 USD | 10 percent | 660 | 18 |
| 24-Month Equal Payment Plan | 24 | equal payment | 2499.00 USD | 19999.00 USD | 10 percent | 672 | 18 |
| 36-Month Equal Payment Plan | 36 | equal payment | 4999.00 USD | 34999.00 USD | 15 percent | 690 | 21 |
| 48-Month Bridal Equal Payment Plan | 48 | equal payment | 7499.00 USD | 59999.00 USD | 20 percent | 704 | 21 |

## 2. Holdings and joint applicants by term

| Term | Second applicant may be named | Plans of this term one customer may hold open at once | Aggregate promotional balance cap across the customer's open plans | Share of the approved credit line this term may consume | Price of a protection plan may be added to the financed balance | Upgrade credit may be applied against the financed principal |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 6-Month Deferred Interest Plan | no | 3 | 9999.00 USD | 80 percent | no | yes |
| 12-Month Deferred Interest Plan | no | 2 | 14999.00 USD | 85 percent | yes | yes |
| 18-Month Deferred Interest Plan | yes | 2 | 19999.00 USD | 90 percent | yes | yes |
| 24-Month Equal Payment Plan | yes | 1 | 24999.00 USD | 90 percent | yes | yes |
| 36-Month Equal Payment Plan | yes | 1 | 39999.00 USD | 95 percent | yes | yes |
| 48-Month Bridal Equal Payment Plan | yes | 1 | 64999.00 USD | 95 percent | yes | yes |

## 3. What each line of the schedule means

- **Promotional term** is the length of the promotion in whole months, counted from the activation date.
- **Interest structure** says how the promotion prices interest: a *deferred interest* term holds the interest back and bills all of it if the balance is not cleared, while an *equal payment* term charges a fixed reduced rate throughout.
- **Smallest and largest financed amount** bound the amount the term may be written for, in USD, measured on the amount financed.
- **Smallest down payment** is the share of the pre-tax ticket that must be paid at the till on the day of sale.
- **Lowest bureau credit score** is the lowest three-digit score the term may be approved at.
- **Minimum applicant age** is the smallest age in whole years at which an applicant may be approved for the term.
- **Second applicant** says whether a joint applicant may be named on the plan.
- **Plans of this term held open at once** counts how many plans of the same term one customer may hold open together.
- **Aggregate promotional balance cap** is the largest combined balance across all of the customer's open plans that the term may be written against.
- **Share of the approved credit line** is the portion of the approved line this term may consume.
- The two closing lines say whether a protection plan's price may join the financed balance and whether an upgrade credit may be set against the financed principal rather than paid out.

## 4. Reading the schedule across terms

The bands are graduated: each longer term opens at a larger smallest amount, closes at a larger largest amount, and asks for a higher score. The 6-Month Deferred Interest Plan and the 12-Month Deferred Interest Plan take no down payment at the till; the 18-Month Deferred Interest Plan and the 24-Month Equal Payment Plan take 10 percent; the 36-Month Equal Payment Plan takes 15 percent; and the 48-Month Bridal Equal Payment Plan takes 20 percent. Only the two longest terms raise the applicant age to 21; the four shorter terms are approved from 18. A second applicant is admitted on every term from the 18-Month Deferred Interest Plan upward and on neither of the two shortest terms. The three equal payment terms each admit only one open plan of the same term per customer.
